progressionBinding.role: Only server-authoritative class completion results are converted into durable progression.
progressionBinding.currentCanonicalRule: Progression points are currently derived from completion correctness/attempt count inside ProgressionBinding; this is existing Pip High progression semantics, not a verified RHS2 activity scoring formula.

progressionRepository.role: Exactly-once progression repository with completion-id conflict detection and compare-and-swap persistence.

persistenceProvider.role: Single canonical durable adapter; live mode uses PipHighProgressionV1 and unpublished Studio uses the memory adapter.

guarantees: failed durable save blocks return to free roam
pending completion blocks another class and explicit leave
retry reuses the original submission identity
post-commit replay is duplicate rather than a second award
rejoin restores one committed completion and points
duplicate completion id is idempotent when payload matches
conflicting payload under the same completion id is rejected
compare-and-swap retries preserve concurrent durable state
failed save does not mutate local committed state

client.role: Read-only presentation consumer for GetProgressionState and server-returned progressionState; no client progression write authority.

durableProgression: P2 activity presentation must not create a second persistence store or progression authority.
Completion remains gated by ClassProgressionCoordinator -> ProgressionBinding -> ProgressionRepository.
A failed durable commit keeps the player in progression-pending state and cannot show a successful return-to-free-roam outcome.
Save/rejoin acceptance remains exact-canonical runtime evidence, not inferred from headless tests.
ephemeralActivityScoring: Observed dodgeball/dance/cook scores, lives, team counts, streaks, multipliers, grades and floating rewards are presentation evidence only.
P2 may carry server-returned ephemeral score/grade fields for presentation, but must not derive durable progression by reverse-engineering sampled footage values.
Do not reinterpret current Pip High 25/15/10 durable points as RHS2 minigame score semantics.
Any future change to durable progression amounts is a separate progression-scope decision requiring deterministic migration/idempotency coverage.
mobileReadOnly: Class/activity HUD and Report Card presentation must stay within the same safe-area and movement/camera exclusion rules used by canonical responsive HUD work.
Client may display server-returned points, grade, score, rewards and completion state but cannot authorize or persist them.
Result dismissal must restore compact HUD and movement/camera state only after the server outcome permits returnToFreeRoam.

futureProducerAcceptance: No second progression repository, persistence provider, reward writer or completion authority.
One durable completion id per authoritative classKey remains sufficient to suppress duplicate durable awards.
Activity action ids and completion ids are deterministic/idempotent and covered by mutation-sensitive tests.
Runtime failure injection proves no false Report Card success and no free-roam release before durable commit.
Rendered iPhone/iPad checks include the active activity HUD, completion summary, pending-save state and restored free roam.
Save/rejoin on the exact future producer canonical restores the committed result exactly once.

riskNotes.risk: A future activity implementation could accidentally treat visible minigame score as durable Pip High progression.
riskNotes.mitigation: Keep ephemeral activity score/grade in class-session response/presentation fields and feed only the canonical completion contract into ProgressionBinding unless an explicitly scoped progression change is approved.

riskNotes.risk: A polished Report Card could visually imply success before the durable commit succeeds.
riskNotes.mitigation: Pending persistence must render a distinct pending/retry state and keep returnToFreeRoam=false until the same completion identity commits.

riskNotes.risk: A classroom result/activity surface could regress the recently repaired iPhone safe-area and touch-control clearance.
riskNotes.mitigation: Reuse responsive layout/exclusion helpers and require desktop/iPhone/iPad geometry plus rendered device evidence.
